purpose: Teach: 松岡/呉/伊東/藤沢/永井/尾崎/黒田/英寿

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがTOKIOの松岡さんの番組を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad's watching that TOKIO program with Matsuoka right now.
lines.style: Gentle observation, warmth underneath. Soft opening. Passing along information like sharing something noticed. Unhurried pace, trailing slightly at the end like she's just remembering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと広島県呉の戦艦大和の展示を観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I went to see the Yamato battleship display in Kure, Hiroshima.
lines.style: Bright, specific pride in the memory. Quick opening attack with excitement. Eager to share the detail. Natural kid pacing, words tumbling slightly forward. Genuine warmth toward Mei.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「伊東温泉旅行を計画する」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying he's planning a trip to Ito hot springs.
lines.style: Noticing tone, slightly amused by his enthusiasm. Soft, warm. Indirect way of sharing — not pushing, just letting him know. Small smile under the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと藤沢周平の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I read a picture book by Fujisawa Shuhei together.
lines.style: Simple joy in the sharing. Unhurried, genuine. The pride of having done something with Dad. Natural kid cadence, open and direct without trying to impress.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが永井路子先生の歴史小説を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad's reading history novels by Nagai Michiyo right now.
lines.style: Casual interest in what he's drawn to. Warm but not effusive. Passing along small observations the way someone who pays attention does. Slight trailing off like she's thinking of other things too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと尾崎豊さんの曲を聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I watched videos of Nakata Hidetoshi's retirement match.
lines.style: Quick, energized opening. Eager to share the specific memory. Kid excitement without being loud. Direct and unguarded, the way he talks when he's genuinely happy about something.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが黒田官兵衛のNHK大河ドラマを観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad's watching the NHK Taiga drama about Kuroda Kanbei.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Soft opening. Noticing and sharing what he notices about the people around him. Warm but understated. Slight pause before the end, like she's watching him register it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと中田英寿さんの引退試合の動画を観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I watched a video of Nakata Hidetoshi's retirement game together.
lines.style: Closing warmth and gratitude. Bright, direct opening. Kid sincerity without self-consciousness. Slight lift at the end — the satisfaction of having been included in something that mattered. Genuine and unhurried.
